status: Post-STOP Codex correction; not supplied to the model; original accepted STOP preserved
termination_reason: The accepted STOP is supported as a bounded decision after two failed independent acceptance checks. It does not validate every scientific claim in its prose. Two different schedules and a changed search formulation cannot establish a controlled refinement gain or slow convergence relative to history. An iteration-3 retained candidate from a CPU-limited revision cannot refute an entire regularization mechanism, exclude warm-start artifacts, prove an intrinsic speed boundary, establish a dominant error cause, or exclude weight/design choices generally. Zero gap at one iterate does not show that changed weights cannot alter a search path or feasible basin. Both new candidates exist; the optional third replay could in principle answer a specific new question about one of them without another NLP, but the model chose no such question. Its quoted 1974.3 numerical seconds remaining preceded the final focused checks and saved-output evaluation; exact counters below use the recorded cumulative state. Its statements of under-one-percent speed changes are corrected by the numerical percentages below. Earlier separately labeled corrections were supplied before its final decision; this correction is recorded after acceptance with no further provider request.
